theorem prop_12_1_2 {x δ₀ Q₀ C : ℝ} {a : ℕ → ℂ} (ha : PrimeSupported x a)
    (hδ₀ : 2 ≤ δ₀) (hQ₀ : 1 ≤ Q₀) (hx : δ₀ * Q₀ ^ 2 ≤ x / 2)
    (hC : ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → Even q → (q : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Q₀ → ∀ s : ℝ, 1 ≤ s → s ≤ 2 * Q₀ / q →
      Gq q (2 * Q₀ / (s * q)) ≤ C * Gq q (2 * √(x / (2 * δ₀)) / (s * q))) :
    ∫ α in Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ majorArcs δ₀ Q₀ x, ‖expTsum a α‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * ∑' n, ‖a n‖ ^ 2 :=

note: As [H] Proposition 12.1.2, up to notation. Lean needs δ0 ≥ 2 (for 2Q ≤ √x, because its common modulus includes odd q ∈ (Q, 2Q]); the book's δ0 ≥ 1 is sound, and both applications use δ0 ≥ 8.
